subject: Your quick demo: pick a 15-min slot + timezone check
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Lopez <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome — quick 15-minute walkthrough options

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for a trial — welcome aboard. I’m Kimberly on the Redwood team; we run a short, focused 15-minute session that covers: a quick walkthrough of latency/cost controls, how the Dedicated offering maps to predictable throughput, and a 10-minute live Q&A with an engineer if you want.

If you’re ready, pick a 15-minute slot using this one-click link: https://app.redwood.inference/schedule?slot=15min&token=abc123 — the link will show available times in your timezone.

If you prefer, reply with 2-3 windows and I can have an engineer join. Also let me know if you need an invitation for someone else on your team.

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Lopez <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick 15-minute walkthrough options

Thanks, Kimberly — got the auto email and the checklist. Quick question: my team is in EDT (New York). When I click the link I see Pacific times; is there a way to force it to show Eastern? Also, can a solutions engineer join? I’d like someone technical on the call to confirm integration constraints.

Attendees: Alex Lopez (Acme Analytics), Priya Menon (CTO, priya@acme-analytics.com)

—Alex

> Thanks, Kimberly — got the auto email and the checklist. Quick question: my team is in EDT (New York). When I click the link I see Pacific times; is there a way to force it to show Eastern? Also, can a solutions engineer join? I’d like someone technical on the call to confirm integration constraints.

Hi Alex — Connor here from Solutions. Kimberly, thanks for the intro.

Alex — the scheduler respects browser/local timezone but we can also add a &tz=America/New_York flag to the booking URL so it opens in EDT. Try this link: https://app.redwood.inference/schedule?slot=15min&token=abc123&tz=America%2FNew_York

I’m available to join the 09:30–11:00 EDT block tomorrow and the 14:00–16:00 EDT block on Wednesday for a 15-minute sync. Mateo (cc’d) can host the technical portion; I’ll add a short engineer prep note and the mini checklist. Sending a provisional calendar invite attached (engineer-availability.ics).

Attachments: engineer-availability.ics (Calendar invite)

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor@redwoodinference.com
